# Mails.so

Mails is an API service that provides powerful email validation capabilities to help maintain a clean and effective email list.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mails-so/.

## Actions

- **Retrieve Batch Results** (read-only): Retrieve results of a bulk validation job.
- **Validate Bulk Emails** (read-only): Validate multiple email addresses in bulk.
- **Validate Single Email** (read-only): Validate a single email address.
